ValidationRule.description: Validation to check if Email value is provided in proper format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT ISBLANK( Email ) , NOT(ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)), NOT REGEX( Email , $Label.Regex_Email ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c), OR( Skip_Validations__c = 'SkipValidation', Skip_Validations__c = 'Validate' ) ) ), NOT( AND( IsNew(), Skip_Validations__c = 'Clone')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Email in correct format.
